subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: The tracker shall expose the ready-set predicate — open ∧ carries the authorization signal ∧ has no open blocker ∧ is not a structural rollup (epic/plan) ∧ has no closing disposition — as one implementation shared by the engine and the CLI.
rationale: one predicate, one place (AP-11/INV-30); readiness drove a token-burning re-fire loop when it diverged
fit_criterion: the ready set matches a hand-computed expectation over a fixture corpus; the CLI and port return byte-identical sets
